plan.question: Does frozen SCET improve on one raw scorer given simple learned list-based allocation and top-one abstention?
plan.fitting: Original fitting IDs only; three identifier-hashed query folds; no calibration/test labels used for training or choosing C.
plan.top1_gate_target: Membership label of the raw scorer first-ranked candidate, predicted using query-list score summaries.
plan.top1_C_selection: Minimum query-fold out-of-fold Brier score, then smaller C.
plan.list_target: Membership of each of the raw scorer first five candidates; query-balanced weights; no class balancing.
plan.list_C_selection: Lexicographic OOF precision, annotated-hit query fraction, annotated items/query at 100 items/100 fitting queries; then smaller C.
plan.ordering: Raw scorer candidate order with original fixed tie keys is preserved; cap-five predictions use cumulative minima with nextafter for strict prefix ordering.
plan.prospective_thresholds: Independent calibration order statistics, scores and existing tie keys; a top-one policy saturates at 100 items/100 queries.
plan.fixed_budget: Label-free batch score order admits min(number of queries, eligible candidates); diagnostic only, separately labelled.
plan.risk_thresholds: 101 fitting-prediction quantiles plus +/-infinity fixed before calibration labels. Calibration chooses maximum admitted count subject to empirical query-error or no-evidence-admission target. No finite-sample risk guarantee is claimed for these controls.
plan.reporting: All sources, models, Cs, thresholds and specified operating points retained. No test-side model or operating-point choice.
plan.bootstrap: 1000 paired query-cluster draws, shared across overlapping partitions, frozen decisions. Primary prospective workload 100, exact budget, and calibration risk targets 0.1/0.2; pointwise 95% intervals.
plan.smoke: FEVER seed13: first 600 fitting, 200 calibration and 300 test IDs; full starts only after finite predictions, disjoint splits, label/order invariance, prefix and independent calibration checks pass.
